arcs.title: Above Marker 9
arcs.summary: Day 4: Ashworth's reply arrived at nine-oh-six Tuesday morning — three words: 'It is a room.' She did not elaborate on the type of room, its contents, or whether she has been inside. The unlabelled circle on the sketch is now provisionally called the Room. Steve has been informed; the Jeep has been informed; the expedition file has been updated with a run date pending. Day 5 should be the run itself: Christine and Steve drive the spur above Marker 9, make the shelf, and reach or glimpse the Room — a natural stone chamber, a clearing with walls, something that earns the name. The resolution should be warm and a little awe-struck, with a moment of Christine and Steve in it together, and perhaps a small final word from Ashworth confirming she knew it was worth finding.
